Overview

See why Kashmir is called paradise on earth. Stay a night on a houseboat on Dal Lake, ride the Gondola in Gulmarg, walk the valleys of Pahalgam and take in the glaciers of Sonamarg. A great choice for families, couples and first-time visitors to the hills.

Tour highlights

  • Night on a deluxe houseboat on Dal Lake
  • Shikara ride on Dal Lake
  • Mughal Gardens: Nishat, Shalimar and Chashme Shahi
  • Gulmarg with Gondola cable car (optional ticket)
  • Pahalgam: Betaab Valley and Aru Valley
  • Sonamarg day trip to Thajiwas Glacier
✈ Flights🏨 Houseboat🛶 Shikara Ride🍽 Meals

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Srinagar, houseboat & Shikara

Fly from Mumbai to Srinagar. Check in to your houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening Shikara ride past floating gardens and markets.

  • Dinner
Day 2 Srinagar to Gulmarg

Drive to Gulmarg (about 2 hours), the meadow of flowers. Ride the Gondola (optional) to Kongdori or Apharwat for snow views. Overnight in Gulmarg.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 3 Gulmarg to Pahalgam

Drive to Pahalgam via saffron fields and Awantipora ruins. Evening walk by the Lidder river.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 4 Pahalgam sightseeing

Visit Betaab Valley, Aru Valley and Chandanwari by local taxi (paid locally as per union rules). Pony rides are optional.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 5 Sonamarg day trip, back to Srinagar

Drive to Sonamarg, the meadow of gold. Optional pony ride to Thajiwas Glacier. Return to a hotel in Srinagar; visit the Mughal Gardens on the way if time allows.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 6 Depart for Mumbai

Visit Shankaracharya Temple or Hazratbal Shrine if flight timing allows, then transfer to Srinagar airport.

  • Breakfast

Good to know

Best time to go: March to October for green meadows; December to February for snow.

Frequently asked questions

Is Kashmir safe for tourists?

Tourist areas like Srinagar, Gulmarg, Pahalgam and Sonamarg see lakhs of visitors every year. We use trusted local partners and keep you updated on any advisories.

Why are local taxis not included?

In Pahalgam and Sonamarg, local unions run the taxis to the valleys and do not allow outside cars. Rates are fixed and paid directly there.
